name: dsh-plugin-vajraclaw
description: Local tool-call failsafe for DSH: blocks a fixed list of high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, with a per-session hash-linked JSONL audit log, and an optional external Gateway for centralized policy.
author: Top-Celestial Company Ltd. / Jimmy Chen <service@dr-os.io>

dsh.description: Local tool-call failsafe for DSH with regex shell pattern blocking, credential read protection, hash-linked JSONL audit log, and optional external Gateway support.

enableEmbeddedEngine.title: Enable Embedded Failsafe Engine
enableEmbeddedEngine.description: Enable zero-latency local pattern failsafe for high-risk shell commands and credential files.

strictFailClosed.title: Strict Fail-Closed Mode
strictFailClosed.description: When false (default), fallback gracefully to embedded local engine if external Gateway is unreachable.

gatewayUrl.title: DROS Gateway Endpoint
gatewayUrl.description: Optional URL for external DROS Gateway. Default is empty (disabled).

licenseKey.title: Gumroad Commercial License Key
licenseKey.description: Optional commercial license key for enterprise cluster scaling.
